build_quantize_method: build a quantization method class that implements create_weights and apply for a quantized neural network layer
create_quantization_config: create a quantization config class that specifies supported dtypes, minimum GPU capability, and layer mapping for a quantization method
test_method_has_implemented_embedding: test whether a quantize method class has a custom embedding implementation beyond the base class
refactor_quantization_config_from_config: refactor a quantization config from a HuggingFace config dictionary using from_config and get_from_keys
review_quantize_method_apply: review the quantize method apply method that applies layer weights to an input tensor
